info.name: UiPath Automation Hub Alerts Licenses API
UiPath Get License Allocation for a Group

params.name: organizationName
params.description: The name of the UiPath organization

params.name: accountId
params.description: Unique identifier of the organization account

params.name: groupId
params.description: Unique identifier of the user group

items.docs: Retrieves the user license allocation rule for a specific group within the organization account. Returns the license types allocated to the group and the current usage count. Requires the PM.License or PM.License.Read OAuth scope.

info.name: UiPath Update License Allocation for a Group

params.name: organizationName
params.description: The name of the UiPath organization

params.name: accountId
params.description: Unique identifier of the organization account

params.name: groupId
params.description: Unique identifier of the user group

items.docs: Allocates or updates user licenses for a specific group. The rule defines which license types members of this group are entitled to. This controls the licenses automatically assigned when a member of the group first logs in. Requires the PM.License OAuth scope.
